# Default keymaps

Effective default shortcuts per bundled keymap, after applying keymap inheritance (`parent=`), plugin-declared shortcuts, `use-shortcut-of`, and the macOS rule that swaps Ctrl and Cmd for shortcuts inherited from a non-macOS parent. Full data for all 26 keymaps is in [data/keymaps.json](data/keymaps.json).
